reasons: Deviation is correctly identified: a mutual cap at one month of Fees 'actually paid' falls below the walk-away floor (6 months) and the preferred greater-of-12-months/USD 1,000,000 basis, and 'without exception' collapses all carve-outs into that cap.

The redline reaches the preferred position with a targeted edit to the single cap sentence: it keeps mutuality ('each Party'), changes the basis to the greater of 12 months' Fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, and removes 'without exception' by re-opening the Excluded Claims carve-out.

Reliance on the existing Excluded Claims regime in 21.2–21.3 (rather than restating carve-outs) is consistent with the redline guidance to edit rather than rewrite the section; the rationale confirms those clauses already cover indemnification, confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP, plus the payment-obligations point.

The 0.660 changed-character ratio is acceptable here — the sentence is short and the rule requires replacing the cap basis and the 'without exception' override, so no smaller edit would reach the position.
Comment is accurate, first-person plural, states the position, explains both changes, and offers the sensible 12-months-fees fallback with carve-outs preserved.

Minor residual risk: if 'Excluded Claims' is not in fact a defined term in 21.2/21.3, the inserted reference would be undefined — worth a confirmation against the surrounding sections, but the finding's cited context supports it.
